annotations.text: O-11 — the loose-goods cart row. ADR-0005: for any product with allows_fractional = 1 the whole-number stepper is replaced by typed weight OR typed amount entry. Sealed packs are unchanged. The Till summary has no "Discounts" line (ADR-0008 / ADR-0020).

Money (ADR-0007): the line total is rounded half-up to the whole rupee once, at the line. On a "by amount" line the rupees typed are authoritative and are stored as-is — the weight is derived and shown with a ≈.

O-9 — Sale Complete auto-advance. The Design System says the screen "offers an auto-advance countdown". This is it: a quiet progress ring on Start next sale, ~8s, any key or tap cancels and keeps the calm screen.
